facts.fact: 她回小屋放薰衣草香草浴片冲澡。
facts.anchor: I head straight for my bathroom, toss a lavender-vanilla shower steamer into the shower pan, and turn on the water.

facts.fact: 偏头痛发作恶心，赶在最后一刻冲进浴室吐完。
facts.anchor: I make it just in time to empty the contents of my stomach, before sitting back against the shower door.

facts.fact: Everett 发现她的靴子还在屋里、她从不错过牧场活计，担心进屋。
facts.anchor: “Well, her boots are still here. She’s never late for ranch work,” Everett states. He sounds concerned.

facts.fact: Brooks 把被单拉到她胸口，Everett 把冷毛巾敷上她疼痛的眼睛。
facts.anchor: Brooks pulls the sheet to my chest and Everett places the cold washcloth on my head, unrolling it just enough to cover my aching eyes.

facts.fact: Everett 把两粒药片按进她颤抖的手心，她就水吞下。
facts.anchor: My brother presses two round pills into my other trembling hand and I toss them both into my mouth with a gulp of water

facts.fact: 再醒来已是傍晚五点以后，睡了一整天。
facts.anchor: It’s after five in the evening already. I’ve slept the entire day away.

facts.fact: Everett 转述：Brooks 一离开就打电话给 Harriet 许好处请她做汤，见她病倒大受震动。
facts.anchor: “Brooks called her when we left earlier. Think he bribed her with something for it. He was really shook up seeing you sick, Ashey. You guys are okay now, right?”

facts.fact: Everett 带来 Harriet 的鸡肉面汤，在厨房折纸照看她。
facts.anchor: “Told you I’d check in on you. Brought some of Harriet’s chicken noodle soup. You owe my wife an apology, by the way.”

relations: Brooks 是她自觉「不可想要」的禁忌对象
